title: Debugging a Broken Data Pipeline at 2 AM
problem: A nightly ETL pipeline that feeds the analytics dashboard failed silently. The dashboard was showing stale data from two days ago, and the sales team had a board meeting in the morning.
description: Priya walks through how she debugged a broken data pipeline — tracing the failure from the dashboard back through the orchestration layer, finding a schema change in an upstream API that broke the ingestion step, and deploying a fix before the morning meeting.
process: Got an alert at 2 AM that the dashboard data hadn't refreshed.
Checked the Airflow DAG — the ingestion task had failed but the DAG itself showed 'success' because of a misconfigured retry policy.
Looked at the ingestion logs. Found a JSON parsing error: a field that used to be a string was now an array.
Checked the upstream API changelog — they had pushed a breaking change without versioning.
Wrote a quick schema migration to handle both the old and new format.
Tested locally against a sample of the new API response.
Deployed the fix and triggered a manual backfill for the missing days.
Added a schema validation check at the ingestion step so this type of silent failure would be caught immediately in the future.
result: Dashboard was showing fresh data by 5 AM. Added schema validation that has since caught three similar issues before they reached production.
